title: Files, CSV and JSON
learning_objectives: Read and write text files safely with with open(...)
Save and load structured data with json
entry_point: write_lines(path, lines); read_lines(path); load_scores_csv(path); save_json(path, data); load_json(path); summarize_scores(csv_path, json_path)
hints: `with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:` then `fh.write(line + "\n")` in a loop.
`fh.read().splitlines()` drops newlines; open CSV files with `newline=""` and use `csv.DictReader(fh)`.
For `top`, keep the first maximum: loop and update only when `score > best_score`.

failure_feedback.advice: Write `line + "\n"` for each line and read with `splitlines()`.
Open with mode `"w"`, which replaces the file, not `"a"`.
Use `csv.DictReader` (it handles the quoted comma) and convert scores with `int`.
Round the mean to 2 decimals and keep the first name with the highest score.
With no rows, mean and top are None.
